changes.text: Happy Halloween! There's a third theme next to dark and light until the end of November: Fall colors, with purple where it's usually blue, a plum-black background and a few pumpkin-orange touches. Green and red still mean up and down, and amber still means a warning. To try it, press the theme button in the top bar until you see it (it shows a leaf from dark mode), or pick Fall colors in the phone menu. After November it goes back to dark.
